question: Which of the following is NOT a sub-field of Economic Geography?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Demography.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Demography is **the study of demographics, the social characteristics, and statistics of a human population**.
 
• This study of the size, age forms and economics of dissimilar populations can be used for a **diversity of purposes**.
 
• The field of demography can be split into two general areas, **basic or academic demography and applied demography**.
 
• A demographic mentions to** distinct characteristics of a population.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38e6ace82a7c62760eea65c5a4d42c58b7ef9ec5b99c9b6960039899e8f66c74.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Resource geography by its very name is **the study of the spatial variation in the physical stuff with regard to their appraisal by humans**. 
 
• **Geography of Marketing** works on the concept that people in that place have alike** needs, wants, and cultural considerations.**​
 
• Geography is important to the study of tourism because** tourism is geographical in nature.**** **
